headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: July 9, 2026**
article:
The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants, securing a 10-0 victory. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs. The Chicago Cubs outlasted the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 9-7 win in a closely contested game. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with a pair of home runs and two RBIs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups. Tanner Banks has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Philadelphia Phillies due to a left forearm strain. Brad Lord has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Washington Nationals retroactive to July 6, 2026, due to left side tightness. Owen Caissie has been placed on the 10-day injured list by the Miami Marlins due to a right calf strain. John King has been placed on the 15-day injured list by the Miami Marlins retroactive to July 8, 2026, due to a left lateral ankle sprain.

Several teams have made roster moves, including trades. The New York Mets acquired RHP Matt Seelinger from the Detroit Tigers for cash. The Detroit Tigers traded RHP Woo-Suk Go to the Minnesota Twins for cash. The Philadelphia Phillies traded RHP Ryan Degges to the Cleveland Guardians for cash. The Houston Astros traded LHP Tom Cosgrove to the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Blue Jays Shut Out Giants 10-0**
top_news.summary: The Toronto Blue Jays dominated the San Francisco Giants, securing a 10-0 victory. Kazuma Okamoto led the Blue Jays' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 4 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Orioles in Thrilling 9-7 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs outlasted the Baltimore Orioles, securing a 9-7 win in a closely contested game. Pete Crow-Armstrong led the Cubs' offense with a pair of home runs and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Torkelson's Homer Leads Tigers to Victory**
top_news.summary: Spencer Torkelson hit a 15th home run of the season, a fly ball to left field that scored two runs, as the Detroit Tigers defeated the Athletics 6-1. Troy Melton earned the win with 5.1 innings of scoreless relief, striking out nine batters.

top_news.title: **Braves Shut Out Pirates 3-0**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a shutout victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Dylan Dodd earning the win. Joey Bart led the Braves' offense with a home run and two RBIs.

top_news.title: **Braves Blast Pirates 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves secured a 10-5 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Matt Olson and Drake Baldwin leading the charge for the winning team.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Royals 7-3**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured a 7-3 victory over the Kansas City Royals, with Lane Thomas and Bobby Witt Jr. leading the way for the losing team. Sean Manaea was among the standout pitchers in the game.

top_news.title: **Phillies Place Tanner Banks on 15-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Tanner Banks, a left-handed pitcher for the Philadelphia Phillies, has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a left forearm strain.

top_news.title: **Mets Acquire RHP Matt Seelinger in Trade**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets have acquired right-handed pitcher Matt Seelinger in a trade with the Detroit Tigers, who received cash in return.
